# European Union

> > Official gateway to the European Union, covering EU institutions, member states, policies, citizenship rights, and the euro currency.

This is the primary public information portal for the European Union, providing comprehensive information about the European Commission, European Parliament, European Council, and Council of the EU. It serves citizens, residents, and visitors with details on living, working, and traveling in the EU, as well as policy information on environment, taxation, food safety, and regional development.

## Key Topics

- European Commission
- European Parliament
- European Council
- Council of the European Union
- Schengen Area
- Euro currency
- EU institutions
- EU member states
- Schuman Declaration
- Food safety and farm-to-fork
- Multilingual support
- Customer service (Europe Direct)
- EU citizenship rights
- Regional policy
- Environmental policy

## Essential Information

- [Your gateway to the EU, News, Highlights](https://european-union.europa.eu/index_en): EU homepage: gateway to institutions, member states, priorities, and news
- [News and stories](https://european-union.europa.eu/news-and-events/news-and-stories_en): Latest EU news: Europol updates, Commission policies, member state events
- [Contact the EU](https://european-union.europa.eu/contact-eu_en): Contact EU institutions via EUROPE DIRECT: phone, email, Messenger support
- [Europe Direct, answering your questions](https://european-union.europa.eu/contact-eu/write-us/answering-your-questions_en): Europe Direct Contact Centre: multilingual EU helpline and customer service

## Living and Traveling in the EU

- [Living in the EU, your rights](https://european-union.europa.eu/live-work-study/living-eu_en): EU citizenship rights: residency, healthcare, consumer protection, family law
- [Travelling in the EU, your rights](https://european-union.europa.eu/live-work-study/travelling-eu_en): EU travel rights: Schengen area rules, free movement, passenger protections

## EU Policies and Actions

- [Environment and green economy – EU action](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic/environment_en): EU environmental policy: green economy, climate action, sustainability initiatives
- [Food safety – EU action](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic/food-safety_en): EU food safety policies: EFSA standards, RASFF system, farm-to-fork approach
- [Regional policy and investment – EU action](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic/regional-policy_en): EU regional policy: investment funding, economic growth, local development
- [Tax – personal, corporate and cross-border](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic/taxation_en): EU tax policy: VAT, excise duties, corporate tax, cross-border coordination

## Institutions and Law

- [Presidents of the European institutions](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/leadership/presidents_en): EU institutional presidents: Roberta Metsola (Parliament), António Costa (Council)
- [Application of EU law](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/law/application_en): EU law application in member states: N-Lex database, EUROJUST cooperation
- [Plan a visit to an EU institution](https://european-union.europa.eu/contact-eu/visit-european-union-institution_en): Visit EU institutions: Parliament, Commission, Council tours and Open Day events

## Euro Currency

- [Euro – official EU currency](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/euro/official-eu-currency_en): Euro currency: official tender in 21 EU countries, eurozone monetary policy
- [Euro – design](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/euro/design_en): Euro symbol and design: Europa series banknotes, ECB copyright rules

## History and Member States

- [Europe Day – May 9](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/europe-day_en): Europe Day (May 9): Schuman Declaration anniversary, EU open days celebration
- [Schuman Declaration May 1950](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/history-eu/1945-59/schuman-declaration-may-1950_en): Historic Schuman Declaration: founding document of ECSC, EU precursor (1950)
- [Slovenia – EU country](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/eu-countries/slovenia_en): Slovenia profile: Ljubljana capital, euro/Schengen member, parliamentary republic
- [Sweden – EU country](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/eu-countries/sweden_en): Sweden profile: Stockholm capital, Swedish krona (SEK), Schengen member state

## Optional

- [Use of languages on our websites](https://european-union.europa.eu/languages-our-websites_en): EU website language policy: eTranslation tool, multilingual content strategy
